toegepas.blok: Die wet wat bo al die ander staan
toegepas.voor: oor skole en paaie en winkels
toegepas.rede_vinder: A list of three reads more naturally with a comma and one 'en' than with 'en' repeated.
toegepas.fout: The repeated 'en' in a plain three-item list reads like loose speech in the lesson's opening sentence.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A comma and one 'en' is the normal written form of a list; the items and meaning are unchanged.

toegepas.blok: Die wet wat bo al die ander staan
toegepas.voor: Een wet staan bo al die ander en ons noem dit die Grondwet.
toegepas.na: Een wet staan bo al die ander, en ons noem dit die Grondwet.
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma: 'en' joins two main clauses with their own subject and verb ('Een wet staan', 'ons noem').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Pure punctuation fix under the AWS rule; no wording changes.

toegepas.blok: Die wet wat bo al die ander staan
toegepas.voor: Die Grondwet is die hoogste wet en elke ander wet moet daarby hou.
toegepas.na: Die Grondwet is die hoogste wet, en elke ander wet moet daarby hou.
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subjects and verbs, so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma: 'en' joins two main clauses ('Die Grondwet is', 'elke ander wet moet ... hou').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Pure punctuation fix; the sentence is study text, not the protected glossary wording.

toegepas.blok: Die Grondwet geld ook vir die regering self
toegepas.rede_vinder: The lesson refers to the Grondwet as 'dit' in the first two blocks and switches to 'hom' here; one pronoun throughout is clearer for a Grade 6 reader.
toegepas.fout: The lesson calls the Grondwet 'dit' in the first blocks and switches to 'hom' here, an inconsistent pronoun for one referent.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same referent and meaning, and 'dit' stays clearly the Grondwet because of the contrast with 'n gewone wet'; kept as a set with 5 and 6 so the lesson uses one pronoun throughout.

toegepas.blok: Die howe hou wag oor die Grondwet
toegepas.rede_vinder: Same pronoun consistency for the Grondwet as in the earlier blocks ('dit', not 'hom').
toegepas.fout: 'hom' for the Grondwet, inconsistent with 'dit' elsewhere in the lesson.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same person and action, only the pronoun is made consistent; part of the set with 4 and 6.

toegepas.blok: Die howe hou wag oor die Grondwet
toegepas.voor: Die howe moet daarom oor hom wag hou.
toegepas.na: Daarom moet die howe daaroor wag hou.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Keeps the pronoun for the Grondwet consistent; with 'daaroor' the sentence reads better starting with 'Daarom'.
toegepas.fout: 'oor hom' for the Grondwet, inconsistent with 'dit' elsewhere.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'daaroor' keeps the same preposition and referent (the courts guard over the Grondwet), and moving 'Daarom' to the front avoids the clumsy 'daarom daaroor'.

toegepas.blok: Die howe hou wag oor die Grondwet
toegepas.voor: Net die hoër howe soos die Hooggeregshof mag beslis
toegepas.na: Net die hoër howe, soos die Hooggeregshof, mag beslis
toegepas.rede_vinder: Commas mark 'soos die Hooggeregshof' as an example, as the glossary does, so it does not read as 'higher courts that resemble the High Court'.
toegepas.fout: Without commas 'soos die Hooggeregshof' runs into the subject and can read as restrictive ('higher courts resembling the High Court').
toegepas.rede_keurder: The commas mark it as an example, which is the intended meaning and matches the glossary's ', soos die Hooggeregshof,'; no words change.

toegepas.blok: Een hof het die laaste sê
toegepas.voor: Sê 'n ander hoër hof 'n wet van die Parlement of 'n provinsiale wet oortree die Grondwet,
toegepas.na: Sê 'n ander hoër hof dat 'n wet van die Parlement of 'n provinsiale wet die Grondwet oortree,
toegepas.rede_vinder: Without 'dat' the reported clause is hard to parse for a Grade 6 reader; 'dat' with the verb at the end makes it clear where the court's statement starts and stops.
toegepas.fout: The verb-first conditional plus an undelimited reported clause with a long subject makes a Grade 6 reader stumble on where the court's statement ends.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'dat' with the verb at the end marks the reported clause clearly, matches the glossary's own construction, and leaves the protected 'geld ... eers wanneer hierdie hof dit bevestig' untouched.
